class Table:
    def __init__(self, rows):
        self.rows = rows

    def count(self):
        return len(self.rows)

    def render(self, separator=" | ", header=None, max_width=None, align="left"):
        lines = []
        if header:
            lines.append(separator.join(header))
        for row in self.rows:
            lines.append(separator.join(str(cell) for cell in row))
        return "\n".join(lines)
